articles.title: Sky's USDS stablecoin shrinks 35% as $1.5 billion exits reserves after illicit-finance report
articles.snippet: USDS held its $1 peg as a large holder linked to Poloniex withdrew much of decentralized protocol Sky's USDC liquidity backing its stablecoins.

articles.title: North Korean hackers used Sky's stablecoin system, putting billions at freeze risk
articles.snippet: Blockchain investigation traced $518 million in illicit-linked activity, including the 2025 Bybit hack, through a key reserve backing DAI and USDS tokens, putting Sky's institutional finance ambitions and open design on collision course.

articles.title: MoonPay seeks US bank charter for stablecoin, custody services
articles.snippet: MoonPay’s proposed national trust bank would offer stablecoin issuance and redemption, reserve management and digital asset custody under federal oversight.

articles.title: Senators warn GENIUS Act rules could push stablecoin firms toward federal oversight
articles.snippet: The lawmakers urged Treasury to extend safe harbor protections to stablecoin issuers in states expected to establish qualifying regulatory frameworks before January 2028.

articles.title: Binance hackers stole 192 tokens across 11 networks, court docs show
articles.snippet: Stablecoins accounted for at least $3.46 billion of the $6.3 billion stolen, while the hackers also took memecoins, tokenized gold and gaming tokens.
